chunks: And by his chain, He said: Among what Allah whispered to Musa (peace be upon him)
He said: 'O Musa! Do not forget Me in every state, for forgetting Me causes the heart to die.'

key_terms.نِسْيَانِي: My forgetting (from the perspective of the speaker)

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of forgetting God on the heart according to the hadith?
ai.summary: In this Hadith Qudsi from Al-Kafi, Allah reveals to Musa (peace be upon him) that spiritual death stems from divine forgetfulness, emphasizing dhikr as the vital sustenance of the heart. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on constant mindfulness of God as a means to preserve the soul's vitality against the stagnation of heedlessness.

en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Among what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Whispered to Musa<sup>as</sup> with was that He<sup>azwj</sup> Said: “O Musa<sup>as</sup>! Do not forget Me<sup>azwj</sup> upon every state, for forgetting Me<sup>azwj</sup> would cause the heart to die’.
en.sarwar: 11. Through the same chain of narrators (it is narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following): “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Of the words of Allah to Moses was that He said, “O Moses do not forget Me in any condition; forgetting Me deadens a heart.”’
